Collapse implement SKILL.md Step 5 to a single run-step5-review --mode loop invocation with token-aware STEP5_REVIEW_STATUS branching; drop duplicate tally/findings-full composition prose.

commit_message:
Absorb Step 5 review loop into review-and-fix Bash wrapper

- Add scripts/lib-implement-round-cap.sh (+ harness) as the single degraded-round inflation helper
- Extend run-step5-review.sh with loop|single|mav-apply modes and --starting-round passthrough
- Split review-and-fix round body, add loop + mav-apply dispatch, and source review-implement-step5-loop.sh
- Rewrite implement SKILL.md Step 5 for one-shot loop dispatch and final STEP5 KV envelope routing

Follow-up: expand test-review-and-fix.sh, test-run-step5-review.sh, test-implement-structure.sh, token-propagation harness, and script-md siblings per the absorbed-loop plan.
todos_left: Add the 16 loop-mode cases to skills/review-and-fix/scripts/test-review-and-fix.sh with REVIEW_AND_FIX_RUN_RELEVANT_CHECKS_SH / LINT_FIX_LOOP stubs to avoid full-repo checks in CI.
Extend scripts/test-run-step5-review.sh for dispatch_loop_default, explicit --starting-round, backward-compat single, and mav-apply argv forwarding.
Extend skills/implement/scripts/test-implement-review-token-propagation.sh and scripts/test-implement-structure.sh per plan (STEP5 parser branches, envelope keys, exit-2 grep guard).
Refresh scripts/run-step5-review.md, skills/review-and-fix/scripts/review-and-fix.md, and scripts/larch-log-batches.md for the new contracts.
Harden review-implement-step5-loop.sh (mav-resume edge cases, flush_review_batches arity on stall paths, skip-ratio awk validation) against live /implement runs.
